aboutPage.title: What is NDXai?
aboutPage.valueProp: NDXai (Neural Dynamics AI) is an artificial intelligence consultancy based in Vic (Barcelona, Spain) that designs, builds and deploys custom AI solutions (predictive maintenance, computer vision, digital twins, AI assistants, advanced analytics and automation) for industrial companies and SMEs that want to cut costs and work more efficiently.

highlights.label: specialists in AI, data and cloud

items.title: Predictive maintenance
items.text:
Every breakdown stop is an irrecoverable loss of time and resources. Using systems based on historical data and AI models, we anticipate failures before they occur, allowing technical interventions to be planned in advance. This reduces maintenance costs and prevents unexpected production interruptions.
For example, in an industrial plant, the system can detect abnormal patterns in a motor's vibration or a pump's temperature, alerting the technical team before a serious failure happens.

items.title: Computer vision
items.text:
Computer vision models inspect products with precision beyond human capability. Through deep neural networks, we detect microscopic defects or irregularities in production lines, ensuring consistent quality standards and reducing product rejection.
This is especially useful in sectors such as pharmaceuticals or food processing, where automatic defect detection can prevent defective batches and improve product traceability.

items.title: Digital twin
items.text:
Digital twins are exact virtual replicas of your physical operations. They allow you to simulate process changes, test improvements, or predict outcomes without halting production.
This technology helps reduce risks and accelerates innovation: for example, a factory can virtually test a new machine configuration or workflow change before implementing it in real life, saving time and costs.

items.title: AI bots and assistants
items.text:
We develop intelligent virtual assistants tailored to different needs: website or app integration, bots for internal information queries, or customer support.
These systems automate repetitive tasks, provide instant responses, and enhance user experience. For example, a customer service bot can resolve common inquiries about orders or billing, while an internal assistant can help teams find documents or data instantly.

items.title: Advanced analytics
items.text:
We turn your company's data into a competitive advantage through Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques. We create models that forecast sales, optimize inventory management, segment customers, or define dynamic pricing.
This enables better-informed decision-making and improves business efficiency. For example, a retailer can adjust promotions based on predicted demand, or a logistics company can optimize delivery routes.

items.title: Intelligent automation
items.text:
We implement AI systems that automate repetitive and administrative processes, reducing errors and freeing up valuable time for your team.
This allows staff to focus on higher-value strategic tasks such as innovation or customer relations. For instance, automating invoice management or order processing can drastically reduce response times and increase productivity.

items.title: A local team in Vic that works on site
items.text: We are based in Vic (Osona) and can visit the plant, talk to operators and see the process in person. Clients deal directly with the people who build the solution, with no sales layer in between.

items.title: Five complementary profiles in one team
items.text: We combine business analysis, data science, data engineering, full-stack development with IoT, and cloud architecture and cybersecurity. One team covers the whole project, from the data to production.

items.title: Custom AI, not off-the-shelf products
items.text: Every model is trained on each client's own data and process, instead of forcing the problem to fit a generic tool. The solution adapts to the plant, not the other way round.

items.title: Focused on industry
items.text: We work on shop-floor problems: breakdowns, quality, processes and production data. We speak the language of maintenance, quality and operations, not just technology.

items.title: Security and cloud by design
items.text: The team has experience with AWS AI services and cloud security in large-scale deployments across Europe and the Americas. Industrial data is handled with cybersecurity in mind from day one.

who.title: Who works with NDXai
items: Industrial companies and production plants in Osona and Catalonia with critical machinery or automated lines.
Food and pharmaceutical manufacturers that need quality control and traceability.
Maintenance, quality and operations managers who want fewer stoppages and rejects.
Logistics and distribution companies that want to forecast demand and optimise routes and inventory.
SMEs that want to automate admin tasks or serve their customers with AI assistants.

how.title: How NDXai works

steps.title: First conversation
steps.text: Tell us about your challenge by email, phone or in person in Vic. We get to know the process, the goal and the data available.

steps.title: Assessment and proposal
steps.text: We assess feasibility and expected impact, then propose scope, timeline and budget.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.text: We build the solution with your data and validate it with your team before deploying it.

steps.title: Go-live and support
steps.text: We integrate the solution into your systems, train your team and keep improving it over time.

items.a: NDXai (Neural Dynamics AI) is an artificial intelligence consultancy based in Vic (Barcelona, Spain). We design and deploy custom AI solutions for industrial companies and SMEs.

items.q: What kind of AI projects does NDXai do?
items.a: Predictive maintenance, computer vision for quality control, digital twins, AI bots and assistants, advanced analytics and process automation. Every project is built around the client's own data and process.

items.q: Where is NDXai based and who does it work with?
items.a: We are based in Vic, in the Osona region of Catalonia. We work with companies across Catalonia and the rest of Spain, and we can visit your plant in person.

items.q: Do I need a lot of data to start an AI project?
items.a: Not necessarily. During the assessment we review what data you already have (historical records, sensors, ERP or spreadsheets) and, if it is not enough, we propose how to start collecting it.

items.q: How much does a project with NDXai cost?
items.a: It depends on the scope and the data available. After the first conversation we prepare a proposal with scope, timeline and budget.

items.q: Which languages does NDXai work in?
items.a: Catalan, Spanish and English. Meetings and project documentation can be in any of the three.
